scope: Exactly three independent source complexity roots. Generated artifacts, suppressions, dependencies and unrelated edits untouched.

rootCauses.name: Search opener presentation complexity
rootCauses.evidence: SearchOpener cyclomatic 23/cognitive 23: label and style decisions obscured registration, responsive mode and focus/open behavior.
rootCauses.impact: Maintenance risk only; no confirmed visible failure or performance improvement claimed.
rootCauses.fix: Extract pure opener styles and module-scope SearchOpenerLabel. Retain palette registration, refs/effects, responsive query, focus and open handler in SearchOpener.
rootCauses.tests: Three new presentation tests pass before/after for labels, ARIA/data attributes, defaults, dimensions/shapes/outline and breakpoint gating. Existing search behavior tests retain keyboard shortcuts, clicked configuration, focus restore, cleanup and mobile mode.

rootCauses.name: Search result status branching complexity
rootCauses.evidence: SearchResults cyclomatic 19/cognitive 24 with nested status branches mixed into query/autocomplete logic.
rootCauses.impact: Maintenance risk; inaccurate status changes could confuse keyboard or screen-reader users. No known such failure fixed.
rootCauses.fix: Extract module-scope SearchStatus with query length, busy/error/count, empty label and retry callback. Keep the polite live region, exact text and decision order; state, debounce, SWR and autocomplete ownership unchanged.
rootCauses.tests: New status sequence test passes before/after for short query, searching, custom empty label, result count and clearing. Existing tests cover stale responses, retry, keyboard/pointer selection, backdrop dismissal and focus.

rootCauses.name: Carousel controls complexity
rootCauses.evidence: LmNukaCarousel cyclomatic 18/cognitive 24: controls rendering mixed with Swiper state and controlled-index synchronization.
rootCauses.impact: Maintenance risk; no intended navigation, rendering or timing change.
rootCauses.fix: Extract module-scope CarouselControls with explicit Swiper/state/configuration props. Preserve parent state/effect/callback ownership, arrows, pagination styles/indicators and navigation methods.
rootCauses.tests: Three new controls tests plus four existing real-Swiper/SSR tests pass before/after: edge disabling, loop/non-loop methods, controlled selection, callbacks, autoplay, indicator changes, hidden controls, SSR slides and alignment.
